API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIoT ReportIot Discovery Resource Get Categories
Iot Discovery Resource Get Categories
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/iotDiscovery/categories

Retrieve the mapping between the device category universally unique identifier (UUID) values and the category names for all the device categories supported by the Zscaler AI/ML. The parent of device category is device type.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
uuid
string

The universally unique identifier (UUID) of the item.

name
string

The name of the item.

parent_uuid
string

The parent UUID of the item.

Note: This field is not applicable for the device types endpoint.

]
